description:
The Rendlesham Forest Incident Documentary | Full Movie |

Join us on a gripping journey into the heart of one of the UK’s most famous and mysterious UFO events — The Rendlesham Forest Incident. In this full-length Rendlesham Forest documentary, we combine three separate investigations conducted over a two-year period to uncover the truth behind the strange lights, unexplained phenomena, and lingering paranormal activity reported deep within the forest.

PART 1: Expert-Led Walkthrough of The 1980 UFO Encounter
We begin with an on-location guided tour by a leading expert on the Rendlesham Forest Incident. Standing at the exact spots where the original sightings occurred in December 1980, we explore the key details of what has been called the UK's Roswell. From military base encounters to mysterious lights and physical evidence, this section sets the historical foundation for the entire investigation.

PART 2: Paranormal Investigation in Rendlesham Forest
In our second investigation, we take a paranormal approach, conducting night-time explorations in the depths of the forest. Using spirit boxes, EMF meters, and other investigative tools, we attempt to connect with whatever energy may still linger in this famously active location.

PART 3: Return to Rendlesham & The Creation of a Dybbuk Box
Two years later, we return to Rendlesham Forest to once again conduct paranormal investigations — but this time with an even darker twist. After collecting materials during the investigation, we create a Dybbuk Box, a haunted object designed to contain spiritual energy. What follows is our most intense experience yet.

🛸 If you're fascinated by UFOs, alien encounters, government cover-ups, and the paranormal — this is the ultimate Rendlesham Forest documentary experience.
